parameters.name: ConnectionStringPrefix
parameters.description:
The prefix of the new connection string. The prefix must meet the following requirements:

- It must consist of lowercase letters, digits, and periods (.).

- It must start with a letter and end with a letter or a digit.

parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the cluster.

> Call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~) operation to view the details of all clusters in your account, including cluster IDs.
